text: The School of Accounting now has two specialties of accounting and financial management, and cultivates postgraduates in partnership with Nanjing University, and coordinates its efforts with Curtin University of Technology to cultivate undergraduates in accounting. The school has about 1500 undergraduate and postgraduate students. Among the 57 full-time teachers, there are 21 professors and associate professors, 12 PhDs (including PhD candidates) and 24 Master's degree holders. In recent five years, 19 treatises and compilations and around 400 theses have been published in journals such as Accounting Research, Management World, Industrial Economy in China and Audit Research. The school has participated in one national standard establishment, fulfilled 20 ministerial and provincial research projects, 2 provincial horizontal projects and been awarded 7 ministerial and provincial prizes. B.A. Financial management Objectives: This program will train the students with modern financial management, capital management, and financial policies. The graduates will be qualified for financial management， accounting work, and research work in governmental institutions, domestic and international enterprises, finance and stock institutions. Objects: Four-year Bachelor of Management Degree Main Courses: Economics, Management, Monetary and Banking, Management Information System, Economic Law, Marketing, Investment Economics, Financial Accounting, Cost Accounting, Management Accounting, Elementary-level (medium, high) Financial Management, Multinational Finance, Cost Management, Accounting Statement Analysis, Interior Control System, Auditing, etc.
